title: fanoutqa: What is the smallest country by population that has won multiple UEFA European Championship? (c4c57d0e2a79f7fc)

chat_history.content: What is the smallest country by population that has won multiple UEFA European Championship?

content.content:
User asks: "What is the smallest country by population that has won multiple UEFA European Championship?" So need to identify among countries that have won the UEFA European Championship (Euro) multiple times, which has the smallest population.

Euro winners: Germany (West Germany) 3 times (1972, 1980, 1996), Spain 3 times (1964, 2008, 2012), France 2 times (1984, 2000), Soviet Union 1, Czechoslovakia 1, Netherlands 0, Italy 2 (1968, 2020), Portugal 1, Greece 1, Denmark 1, Netherlands 0, etc. Actually winners list: USSR (1960), Spain (1964), Italy (1968), West Germany (1972), Czechoslovakia (1976), West Germany (1980), France (1984), Netherlands (1988) - wait Netherlands didn't win, they were runner-up. Actually winner 1988 was Netherlands? No, winner was Netherlands? Check: Euro 1988 winner was Netherlands (they beat USSR). Yes they won. So Netherlands have 1. Then Germany (1992), Denmark (1996) is runner-up? Actually Euro 1996 winner was Germany (unified). Euro 2000 winner was France, 2004 Greece, 2008 Spain, 2012 Spain, 2016 Portugal, 2020 Italy.

Multiple winners: Spain (3), Germany (3?), Germany has West Germany 2 (1972, 1980) plus unified 1996 = 3. Italy (2), France (2). So smallest population among these: compare populations: Spain ~47 million, Germany ~84 million, Italy ~60 million, France ~67 million. Smallest is Spain? Actually Spain 47 vs Italy 60 vs France 67 vs Germany 84. So Spain is smallest by population among multiple winners. However check population of Germany historically? Current populations. So answer: Spain. Provide population approximate.

Thus answer: Spain, with around 47 million (2023).

content:
The smallest nation (by population) that has lifted the UEFA European Championship more than once is **Spain**.

| Country | Euro titles | Years won | Approx. population (2023) |
|---------|-------------|-----------|---------------------------|
| Spain   | 3           | 1964, 2008, 2012 | ~ 47 million |
| Italy   | 2           | 1968, 2020 | ~ 60 million |
| France  | 2           | 1984, 2000 | ~ 67 million |
| Germany (West + unified) | 3 | 1972, 1980, 1996 | ~ 84 million |

Thus, among all multiple‑Euro winners, Spain is the least‑populated country.
